options.content: The TikTok channel in Postiz, read by the bridge ${every_tiktok}: account numbers through Postiz (which renews the channel's sign-in), each video's numbers straight from TikTok with that token (needs POSTIZ_DB_PASSWORD, so staging has none). TikTok gives no numbers per day, so followers and likes per day are the bridge's own record, from the day it began collecting.
